nb2_lite.texto: A photograph of the same person shown in the reference image. A middle-aged Australian woman of European descent, fair skin, medium build, in a contemporary blazer. Stands in the advocacy society's office going through case folders. Present-day Perth office of an asbestos victims' advocacy society, filing cabinets, framed photographs of members, 2023. Soft overcast window light. Medium shot, eye-level, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 2023, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio. No readable text, no signage, no labels.
